newsitem.title: USA: Sept Brent crude advances in late U.S. paper trade.
newsitem.headline: Sept Brent crude advances in late U.S. paper trade.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil advanced in late U.S. paper trading on Friday, traders said.
A Wall Street trader picked up two full boats of September Brent at $19.05 a barrel, as well as three partial cargoes totalling 300 lots at the same price.
London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) closed at $18.95 a barrel.
August/September Brent traded higher at plus 40 cents and plus 43 cents a barrel, , up from a deal at plus 30 cents earlier in the day.
September/October traded twice at plus two cents, up a penny from an earlier transaction.
